neighbours.label: boundary token closing a fronted adverbial or topic phrase, before the main clause
fire: He was born in Poland in 1928, and during World War II, he and his family fled east.
The original song was quiet. In the dance remix, however, the drums take over.
The house was empty for years. In the end, the furniture was sold at auction.
It rained all week. On the final morning, the sun finally came out over the hills.
Prices rose sharply. Despite the protests, the council approved the new tax.
The match was close. In the second half, the visitors scored twice.
She studied in Paris. After graduating, she moved back to Lyon to teach.
The road was flooded. Without a boat, the villagers could not reach the town.
